{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_clean = df_clean.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
df_clean = df_clean.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Filter to treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_clean[df_clean["arm"] == "treatment"]

# Step 4: Compute response rate by sex and severity
response_rates = df_treatment.groupby(["sex", "severity"])["responded"].mean().reset_index()
response_rates = response_rates.rename(columns={"responded": "response_rate"})

# Pivot to get F and M response rates by severity
pivot_table = response_rates.pivot(index="severity", columns="sex", values="response_rate")

# Compute difference (F - M) for each severity level
pivot_table["diff"] = pivot_table["F"] - pivot_table["M"]

# Get counts per severity level for weighting
strata_counts = df_treatment.groupby("severity")["sex"].count().reset_index()
strata_counts = strata_counts.rename(columns={"sex": "count"})

# Merge with pivot table
pivot_table = pivot_table.merge(strata_counts, on="severity")

# Compute weighted average difference
total_n = pivot_table["count"].sum()
weighted_diff = (pivot_table["diff"] * pivot_table["count"]).sum() / total_n

# Output
print(f"Adjusted difference in response rate (F - M): {weighted_diff:.4f} ({weighted_diff*100:.2f} percentage points)")

# Return value for submission
weighted_diff"}
